reviews.title: Great!!
reviews.comment: This DDR5 RAM is an absolute steal for the price! It delivers blazing-fast speeds, easily handled everything I threw at it, and gave me a noticeable boost in performance. Installation was a breeze, and it's been running flawlessly ever since. If you're looking to upgrade your memory without breaking the bank, look no further! Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Greyson Kline

reviews.comment: Very fast memory, fits perfectly and is a great value
reviews.author: Dogbreath077

reviews.title: Works Great With UGreen
reviews.comment: Summary: If you're looking for RAM for your UGreen NAS, this works great. I recently upgraded my RAM to a Corsair that UGreen said was compatible, but the system would reset randomly at all hours and was unreliable as a NAS, even after deactivating Watchdog in the BIOS (this is a common issue). I replaced that RAM with this and it has worked flawlessly with no restarts and I could immediately tell the speed improvement.
reviews.author: John

reviews.title: Good and fast RAM
reviews.comment: I got this to increase the RAM in a mini-PC which came with 1 16 GB chip.  Adding the 2nd chip gave me a huge boost to gaming (as the integrated graphics share the system RAM).  I had no issues with it - just plugged it in and it was good.
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.title: Good price, works great!
reviews.comment: I replaced two 8gb memory modules with two of these 16gb memory modules.  Works great with no compatibility issues in an MSI Katana 15 inch laptop..  Good price too.  I ordered 2 single 16gb modules instead of the 32gb kit, because the 32gb kit was out of stock.  It was a few dollars more, but not bad.  Works great!
reviews.author: The Penguin
